Hour-by-hour foot traffic for chosen locations

hourly_profile.Rd

Averages pedestrian counts for each hour of the day at the chosen sensors, over the trading days and months selected. Use it to see when a location is busiest and whether that peak falls inside your opening hours.

Usage

hourly_profile(data, locations, location_ids, days, months = month.abb)

Arguments

data

Average hourly foot traffic, in the format of foot_traffic.

locations

Sensor details, in the format of sensors.

location_ids

Sensor identifiers to include, for example the top three from rank_locations().

days

Days to include, as three-letter abbreviations such as c("Sat", "Sun").

months

Months to include, as three-letter abbreviations. Defaults to all twelve.

Value

A tibble with one row per sensor and hour, with columns location_id, hour (0 to 23), avg_per_hour (average pedestrians in that hour) and location_name.

Examples

# Weekend pattern at the top three weekend locations
top3 <- rank_locations(foot_traffic, sensors, days = c("Sat", "Sun"))$location_id[1:3]
hourly_profile(foot_traffic, sensors, top3, days = c("Sat", "Sun"))
